title: PEPP proposed legal instruments and technical advice: Regulatory Technical Standards
notes: EIOPA (EU supervisor, sells nothing). Bias: consumer-protection mandate, so cost reports stress poor value for money. Bundles several delegated acts; the cost-cap part (types of costs and fees under the 1% Basic PEPP cap) is one section. EIOPA designed and promotes the PEPP, so this material argues for the product.
